meta.title: Digital service logbook — RideLogger
meta.description: RideLogger is a digital vehicle maintenance logbook for service history, fuel, expenses and reminders — for one or more vehicles, on web and phone.
meta.heroImageAlt: Illustration of a digital service logbook: service history, fuel and expenses on phone and desktop.

hero.headline: What is a digital service logbook?
hero.sub: RideLogger is a digital vehicle maintenance logbook — an app where each vehicle has one clear history: services, fuel, expenses and maintenance reminders. It works in the browser and on your phone, for one or many vehicles. In the Balkans the same product is called Servisna Knjižica.

intro.headline: Why digital instead of paper?
intro.body: Paper logbooks get lost, fade and rarely track fuel or small costs. A digital service logbook keeps everything in one place — with reminders before registration, service or tyre changes — and is easy to share when you sell the car.

items.title: Service history
items.body: Log services with date, mileage and notes. Receipt photos stay with the entry.

items.title: Fuel & expenses
items.body: Track fuel use, parking, insurance and other costs per vehicle — clearly over time.

items.title: Reminders
items.body: Set reminders for service, inspection, insurance or tyres — before you forget.

items.title: Multiple vehicles
items.body: Family or small fleet: all vehicles in one account, each with its own history.

items.title: Web & phone
items.body: Use the browser on desktop or the app on your phone — same data, no install required to start.

steps.title: Add a vehicle
steps.body: Enter make, model and current mileage — or several vehicles at once.

steps.title: Log services and costs
steps.body: Add services, fill-ups and expenses as they happen; the history builds itself.

steps.title: Set reminders
steps.body: Choose what to be reminded about — service, registration, tyres — and keep driving with peace of mind.

items.q: Is RideLogger the same app as Servisna Knjižica?
items.a: Yes — the same product, different name in the Balkans (Servisna Knjižica) and globally (RideLogger).

items.q: Do I need to install an app?
items.a: Not right away. You can start in the browser; an Android app is also available on your phone.

items.q: How many vehicles can I track?
items.a: Multiple vehicles in one account — handy for families or if you drive both personal and work cars.

items.q: Does the history help when selling?
items.a: A well-kept service history makes negotiations easier — buyers see what was done on the car.

closing.headline: Ready for a digital service logbook?
closing.body: Open RideLogger, add a vehicle and start logging services and expenses — free to get started.
